description: 2nd connection of this batch. 1st connection failed for two mundane, self-inflicted reasons rather than answering the real question: (1) PASE's sed has no -i flag (`sed: 001-3036 usage: ...`, confirmed in stderr) - iproj.json's YOURUSER2 placeholder was never actually substituted. (2) The BUILD step never exported PATH before invoking bash/makei (each sh-type step is a fresh job, so the SETUP step's environment doesn't carry over) - makei's own check_path() correctly (this time) reported PATH as missing /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin, since it genuinely was. The ZAISRV *MODULE/*SRVPGM rows the 1st connection's OBJECT_STATISTICS collect returned were just Part 7's pre-existing objects, untouched - the BUILD step never got far enough to rebuild anything. Also fixed an invalid PROGRAM_INFO query (used function-call syntax; the confirmed-working form from part08-07-services is a plain WHERE-filtered view, no parentheses). Fixes: iproj.json substitution now goes through python3 binary-mode read/replace/write (same safe recipe as part08-01's ed.py) instead of sed -i or any `>` redirect (which part08-01 already established re-encodes to EBCDIC under this harness's qsh); the BUILD step now explicitly exports PATH inside the same bash -c invocation that calls makei.

steps.label: SETUP
steps.cmd:
rm -rf "$HOME/mk8"
mkdir -p "$HOME/mk8/z/src/qrpglesrc" "$HOME/mk8/z/src/qsrvsrc"
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/src/qrpglesrc/zaisrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/src/qsrvsrc/zaisrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QTXTSRC.FILE/IPROJJSN.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QTXTSRC.FILE/RULESMK.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/Rules.mk') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "p='$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json'; d=open(p,'rb').read(); open(p,'wb').write(d.replace(b'YOURUSER2', b'&LIB'))"
echo ---IPROJ-JSON---
cat "$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json"
echo ---TREE---
find "$HOME/mk8/z" -type f

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB, OBJTEXT FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ZAISRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE
SELECT PROGRAM_LIBRARY, PROGRAM_NAME, PROGRAM_TYPE, PROGRAM_OWNER FROM QSYS2.PROGRAM_INFO WHERE PROGRAM_LIBRARY = '&LIB' AND PROGRAM_NAME = 'ZAISRV'
